title: Epic Universe with Kids: A Family Guide to Universal
description: Planning Universal Epic Universe with kids? What’s there, how tickets work in 2026, the Ministry of Magic and tips for fitting it into an Orlando holiday.
h1: Epic Universe with kids: a family guide
intro: Universal’s newest Orlando park opened in 2025 with five themed worlds, including the Wizarding World of Harry Potter – Ministry of Magic. Here’s how to fit it into a family trip.

blocks.title: Scout’s Epic tip
blocks.text: Check your ticket type before you buy. For 2026, 3-day-plus Universal tickets include Epic Universe visits, but 2-day tickets don’t.
points: Epic Universe is a separate park from the original two
Consider Early Park Admission if your hotel offers it
Height limits vary: check the ride guide

sections.html: Epic Universe opened in May 2025 with a central hub (Celestial Park) and four themed worlds: Super Nintendo World, The Wizarding World of Harry Potter – Ministry of Magic, How to Train Your Dragon – Isle of Berk and Dark Universe (the monster-themed land, which suits older kids best).

Single-day Epic Universe tickets are sold separately. For 2026, multi-day Universal Orlando tickets of three days or more include Epic Universe access, while two-day tickets don’t. Ticket rules change, so check the official Universal Orlando site before you buy.

The Wizarding World is now spread across three Orlando parks: Hogsmeade (Islands of Adventure), Diagon Alley (Universal Studios Florida) and the Ministry of Magic (Epic Universe). See our Harry Potter days out guide.
Orlando is a holiday rather than a day out. Compare Orlando holidays on TravelDeals, and see Disney deals if you’re combining resorts.

faqs.q: Is Epic Universe good for young children?
faqs.a: Yes, especially Super Nintendo World and the How to Train Your Dragon land, which has gentler rides. Dark Universe is themed on classic monsters and suits older children best.

faqs.q: Do Universal Orlando multi-day tickets include Epic Universe?
faqs.a: For 2026, tickets of three days or more include Epic Universe access, while two-day tickets do not. Check the official site, as ticket rules can change.
